title: Midnight Bass Session
description: A man wearing a black cap and heavy silver chain sits at a wooden table playing an electric bass guitar in a dark room. Musical notes float through the air around him, a lit hanging bulb illuminates the scene, and a white styrofoam cup and gold-wrapped item rest on the table while large speakers dominate the shadowy background.
prompt: A Black man wearing a backward cap and thick silver chain sits in a dark, gritty room playing an electric bass guitar at a wooden table. A single bare lightbulb hangs above, casting dramatic light and shadows through blinds on the wall. Swirling musical notes and smoke fill the air, large speakers are visible in the background, a white styrofoam cup and a gold-wrapped item sit on the table, cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, realistic painting style
